brief: Separate a budget category from the account or envelope holding its money.

title.es-MX: El propósito no es la ubicación

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Purpose is not location"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "El propósito no es la ubicación"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Propósito não é localização"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Separate a budget category from the account or envelope holding its money.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A category says what money is for; an account says where it is.
instruction.misconception: Treating a transfer between containers as new income or assuming all money in one account has one purpose.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: One account can hold rent and food money. Transferring food money into an envelope changes location, not purpose.
Groceries names the intended use, not the storage place.
The transfer changes location while the rent purpose remains.
A single account can contain money for different uses.
An internal transfer does not create another wage payment.
Changing a label changes the plan, not the cash total.
One purpose can span multiple storage places.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
